title: 第518章 洗澡第517章 等这次事情结束了你陪我
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
缇亚娜领着肖恩穿过一条长长的走廊。
缇亚娜的脚步很稳，背脊挺得笔直。
但她的内心远没有表面那么平静。
北境的边防，她可以想办法操作。
以冕卫家族的名义，招募一支不受王都节制的私军，再让他们换上德玛西亚的制式装备，名义上归她调遣，实际上听命于肖恩。
这很难，但并非不可能。
可第二个条件……
她甚至不知道该如何去定义那个要求。
肖恩跟在她身后，脚步不紧不慢，带着一种闲庭信步的轻松。
他没有再开口说话，只是安静地欣赏着墙上的画像，偶尔发出一两声意义不明的轻笑。
那笑声在空旷的走廊里显得格外清晰。
终于，她在一扇橡木门前停下。
这扇门就在她自己卧室的旁边，只隔着一道墙。
她转过身，面无表情地看着肖恩：“你今晚就住这儿。”
肖恩的目光越过她，看了看那扇门，又看了看旁边那扇明显更加精致的门，脸上露出了然的笑容。
“邻居？”他问。
缇亚娜没有回答，直接推开了门。
房间很大，陈设典雅，比之前那个被盖伦踹坏门的客房要好上不少。
一张大床，独立的盥洗室，还有一个能看到庄园花园景色的阳台。
“有事就敲墙。”肖恩走进房间，很不见外地在床边坐下，拍了拍身边的床垫，“不过，我希望半夜不会听到什么奇怪的声音。”

缇亚娜的脸颊瞬间又热了起来。
她很想把门摔上，把他一个人锁在这里。
她深呼吸，强迫自己冷静下来。
“你最好安分一点。”她从牙缝里挤出几个字。
“我很安分。”肖恩摊开手，一脸无辜，“不安分的是你那个大侄子。对了，这扇门结实吗？我可不想睡到一半，又有人冲进来喊着要捍卫姑姑的荣誉。”
缇亚娜的太阳穴突突地跳。
她不想再和他多说一句话。
就在这时，门外传来轻轻的敲门声。
“元帅大人。”是侍女艾拉的声音。
缇亚娜皱了下眉，走过去打开门。
艾拉端着一套崭新的男士睡袍和洗漱用具站在门口，当她看到房间里的肖恩时，眼睛里闪过一丝惊讶，但很快就低下头，掩饰了过去。
“元帅大人，我来为客人准备……”
“放下吧。”缇亚娜打断她的话，侧身让开路。
艾拉走进房间，将东西放在床头柜上，全程低着头，眼角的余光却忍不住往肖恩身上瞟。
这个男人……就是今天传得沸沸扬扬的，那个让元帅大人当众失态的年轻人？
看来外界传言非虚，这都快住一起了。
艾拉的心里翻江倒海，但脸上不敢露出分毫。
“元帅大人，您的沐浴热水已经备好了。”她小声提醒道。
“知道了，你先下去吧。”缇亚娜挥了挥手。
“是。”

艾拉躬身退下，在关上门的一刹那，她听到少年用一种轻松的语气说道：“替我谢谢元帅大人的周到安排。还有，等会儿也帮我准备一份热水吧，我和娜娜……一样，都喜欢睡前泡个澡。”
content_en:
Tiana led Sean through a long corridor.
Tiana's steps were steady and her back straight.
But her heart was far from as peaceful as she appeared.
She can think of ways to operate the border defense in the north.
In the name of the Crownguard family, she recruited a private army that was not subject to the control of the royal capital, and had them put on Demacia's standard equipment. They were nominally under her command, but in fact they were under Sean's orders.
It's difficult, but not impossible.
But the second condition...
She didn't even know how to define that request.
Sean followed her, his pace was unhurried and leisurely, with the ease of a leisurely stroll.
He didn't speak anymore, but quietly admired the portraits on the wall, occasionally letting out one or two chuckles of unknown meaning.
The laughter was particularly clear in the empty corridor.
Finally, she stopped in front of an oak door.
The door was right next to her own bedroom, separated only by a wall.
She turned around and looked at Sean expressionlessly: "You will stay here tonight."
Sean looked past her, at the door, and then at the obviously more delicate door next to her, with a knowing smile on his face.
"Neighbors?" he asked.
Tiana didn't answer and opened the door directly.
The room was large and elegantly furnished. It was much better than the previous guest room whose door had been kicked in by Galen.
A large bed, separate bathroom, and a balcony with views of the manor's gardens.
"Knock on the wall if you have anything to do." Sean walked into the room, sat down on the bedside quietly, and patted the mattress next to him, "However, I hope I won't hear any strange noises in the middle of the night."
Tiana's cheeks instantly heated up again.
She wanted to slam the door shut and lock him in here alone.
She took a deep breath and forced herself to calm down.
"You'd better calm down." She squeezed out a few words through her teeth.
"I'm very peaceful." Sean spread his hands with an innocent look on his face, "The restless one is your eldest nephew. By the way, is this door strong? I don't want to have someone rush in and shout to defend my aunt's honor in the middle of my sleep."
Tiana's temples jumped.
She didn't want to say another word to him.
At this moment, there was a gentle knock on the door.
"Master Marshal." It was the voice of the maid Ella.
Tiana frowned and walked over to open the door.
Ella stood at the door holding a brand new men's nightgown and toiletries. When she saw Sean in the room, a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes, but she quickly lowered her head to hide it.
"Marshal, I'm here to prepare for the guests..."
"Put it down." Tiana interrupted her and stepped aside to get out of the way.
Ella walked into the room and put the things on the bedside table. She kept her head down the whole time, but she couldn't help but glance at Sean from the corner of her eyes.
This man... is the young man who caused the marshal to lose his temper in public, which has caused a lot of rumors today?
It seems that the rumors outside are true, they are almost living together.
Ella's heart was in turmoil, but she didn't dare to show it on her face.
"Marshal, the hot water for your bath is ready." She reminded in a low voice.
"I know, you go down first." Tiana waved her hand.
"Yes."
Ella bowed and retreated. The moment she closed the door, she heard the young man say in a relaxed tone: "Thank you, Lord Marshal, for your thoughtful arrangements. Also, please prepare some hot water for me later. Nana and I...like to take a bath before going to bed."
